annotations.title: Private funds an adviser reports on Form ADV

description: Private funds from Form ADV Schedule D 7.B.(1): fund name, SEC fund id (805-...), type, gross asset value with its as-of date (reported gross assets, NOT fund size or commitments), owners, minimum investment, ownership percentages, 3(c)(1) or 3(c)(7), master or feeder, first and last reported, status (reported or dropped) and the Form D file number where the adviser gave one. With include_custodians, each fund's custodians (question 25) with city, state, SEC number and LEI. Filter by adviser (dfx:ria: id or CRD), name, type, status, state, Form D number or minimum gross assets. Fund reporting after 2024-12-31 is roster counts only. With group_by=adviser and a fund_type, ranks advisers instead (which advisers manage the most real estate private fund gross assets): each adviser's CRD, Form ADV link, fund count, summed gross asset value and five largest funds by 805- id, over reported funds with gav_as_of in the last recency_months (default 24, stated in basis). A fund reporting more gross assets than its adviser's total RAUM is left out of the sums and listed in excluded_as_likely_misreported. ACCESS: without a paid DFX plan on the vertical, a list returns its first 5 rows in full and a count of the rest by type (locked.count, locked.by_type), never the rows; a record names its subject and the first 3 related names per section; contact values (email, phone, profile URLs) and decision-maker names are never returned, only their types and counts. Every answer says what it withheld in `entitlement` and `locked`. Full access: DFX Intelligence, 7 days free at https://dfxintel.com/data-factory/plans.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous page of this tool, unchanged.

firm_dfx_id.description: An RIA graph id of the form dfx:ria:<uuid> (from search_ria, resolve_name or search_entities), or the firm's CRD number as a string.

group_by.description: adviser: rank advisers by the summed gross asset value of their funds of fund_type (every type when none is given; basis says whether every fund was read).

include_custodians.description: Attach custodian rows to each fund on the page.

query.description: Fund name contains, an 805- fund id, or a 021- Form D file number.

recency_months.description: Only funds whose gross asset value is dated within this many months. Default 24 with group_by; no window otherwise.

status.description: reported: on the adviser's latest filing; dropped: no longer reported.
